title: Safely Store xcms Result Objects in a Portable Stash
text: xcms result objects can saved restored saveMsObject() readMsObject() functions () MS data stashes. present, XcmsExperiment objects can saved following stash formats: Alabaster-based format: storage MS data xcms results using Bioconductor’s alabaster.base framework saving files HDF5 JSON format. stash format can selected configured passing AlabasterParam saveMsObject() readMsObject() function. alabaster-based stashes also fully support saveObject() readObject() functions alabaster.base. Text file-based format: storage MS data preprocessing results plain text files. stash format can selected configured passing PlainTextParam saveMsObject() readMsObject() function. See also vignette MsStash package details formats documentation vignettes related SpectraStash MsExperimentStash packages information storage result object’s MS data. load example XcmsExperiment result object provided xcms package. XcmsExperiment thus contains full results xcms-based LC-MS data preprocessing, chromatographic peaks, adjusted retention times LC-MS features. next store object xcmsStash using saveMsObject() function AlabasterParam parameter object choose configure alabaster-based stash format. location stash can set path argument parameter object. present example save stash temporary folder. saveMsObject() storing, next results present XcmsExperiment object also experiment-related information MS data containers MsExperiment Spectra, object contains. content thus created stash folder : XcmsExperiment contains, next results xcms preprocessing, also MS data experiment along experiment’s sample information. experiment-relevant information contained MsExperiment object (XcmsExperiment extends), actual MS data experiment represented Spectra object. Calling saveMsObject() XcmsExperiment triggers serialization mechanism contained extended MS data objects. alabaster format slot object stored sub-directory within main xcmsStash directory. Folders chrom_peak_data, chrom_peaks, feature_definitions stash folder contain xcms preprocessing results, xcms_experiment_process_history.json file provides full data processing history (parameter objects object’s processHistory() serialized JSON format). folders contain remaining MS experiment-relevant information respective sub-stashes. spectra folder contains example experiment’s MS data SpectraStash (defined SpectraStash package). XcmsExperiment can restored xcmsStash readMsObject() function along parameter object specifying format stash. load result object alabaster-format stash created use AlabasterParam() parameter object providing file path stash argument. addition need define expected result (return) object first parameter readMsObject() (case XcmsExperiment() object). mentioned , xcmsStash folders organized modular way different components stored sub-folders (sub-stashes). allows load selected parts object instead full object. can example read MS experiment information stash, omitting xcms preprocessing results. even just Spectra object representing MS data experiment spectra sub-folder stash directory: Depending data backend Spectra object XcmsExperiment uses, references actual MS data might stored within xcmsStash. shown print output , loaded Spectra object uses MsBackendMzR backend represent MS data. type backend loads general metadata information memory reads actual MS data -demand original MS data files. can use dataStorageBasePath() function get location original MS data files Spectra object. MS data files thus referenced Spectra object part stash folder. original data files moved another location xcmsStash folder moved different computer, location MS data files needs provided spectraPath parameter readMsObject() function allow restoring object stash (see documentation vignette SpectraStash package information). Alternatively, possible store also MS data files stash folder passing consolidate = TRUE saveMsObject() call: Now stash directory contains also original MS data files, particular example stored within sub-folders KO WT within spectra sub-folder: allows generating self-contained portable stashes, file size much larger, depending number size original MS data files. Finally, xcmsStash package implements also saveObject() readObject() methods alabaster.base package. Thus, full stash, also selected parts result object can read using functions. Loading example Spectra object xcms result object using alabaster’s readObject() function: Next alabaster-based stash format xcmsStash implements also plain text file-based format (PlainTextParam), stores data (human readable) tabulator delimited text files. Additional formats, possibility save xcms results mzTab-M format (RmzTabM package) added future.

Refer documentation MsExperimentStash::MsExperimentStash information format stored MS data sample information. xcms-specific data/folders : chrom_peaks: identified chromatographic peaks (chromPeaks()), stored numeric HDF5 array. chrom_peak_data: data object's chromPeakData(), saved HDF5 format. feature_definitions: object's featureDefinitions(), saved HDF5 format. xcms_experiment_process_history.json: object's processHistory() serialized JSON object.

title: XcmsExperiment Stash — XcmsExperimentStash
text: saveMsObject()/readMsObject() PlainTextParam allows save read xcms result objects text file-based stash. preprocessing results stored separate tabulator delimited text files. files row names (representing either chromatographic peak IDs feature IDs) written first column column names first row. files grouped preprocessing result : Chromatographic peak detection results stored xcms_experiment_chrom_peaks.txt (chromPeaks()) xcms_experiment_chrom_peak_data.txt (chromPeakData()). Correspondence results: definitions LC-MS features (featureDefinitions()) stored xcms_experiment_feature_definitions.txt (one row per feature) assignment chromatographic peaks features ($peakidx column featureDefinitions()) xcms_experiment_feature_peak_index.txt, one row mapping chromatographic peak feature. files created (present stash) correspondence analysis performed. processing history (processHistory()) stored JSON format xcms_experiment_process_history.json.
